name: gitlab-mr
description: Open a GitLab merge request for the job branch or move it to the job's target branch.
script:
set -eu
repo="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_URL"
draft=$(jq -ce '.pull_request')
title=$(printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -er '.title')
description=$(printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -r '.body')
requests=$(glab mr list -R "$repo" --source-branch "$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH" --output json)
id=$(printf '%s\n' "$requests" | jq -r '.[0].iid // empty')
if [ -n "$id" ]; then
  glab mr update "$id" --target-branch "$PECORE_JOB_TARGET" --title "$title" --description "$description" -R "$repo" >/dev/null
else
  glab mr create --source-branch "$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH" --target-branch "$PECORE_JOB_TARGET" \
    --title "$title" --description "$description" -R "$repo" --yes >/dev/null
fi
requests=$(glab mr list -R "$repo" --source-branch "$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH" --target-branch "$PECORE_JOB_TARGET" --output json)
url=$(printf '%s\n' "$requests" | jq -er '.[0].web_url | strings | select(length > 0)')
printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -c --arg url "$url" '. + {url: $url}'
